generator.program.note: The program the authors chose to grow this taxon's shrub species (named in each species' spec until G2.3a moved it here).

traits.note: Hutchinson (vol. 1, 2nd ed., 1959), family 196 Santalaceae: trees, shrubs or herbs, often parasitic on trees or roots; leaves alternate or opposite, entire, sometimes reduced to scales; stipules absent; calyx green or petal-like, 3- to 6-lobed, no petals; ovary inferior or half inferior; fruit a nut or drupe. APG's Santalaceae holds Viscaceae (the mistletoes), whose fruit is a berry.

traits.inflorescence.note: Ronse De Craene, Floral Diagrams (2010) p. 158, 159, family Santalaceae: inflorescence cyme (dichasial arrangement most common), usually; read as {"cyme": "usually"}.

traits.flower_merosity.note: DELTA (read 2026-10-16): Santalaceae s.s. usually 4-5 (3-8); Viscaceae (included in APG Santalaceae) 3-4. Typical 4 inferred from the combined family.

traits.stamens.note: DELTA (read 2026-10-16): Santalaceae 4-5 (3-8), one per perianth lobe; Viscaceae usually 4 (2-4).

traits.leaf_incision.note: DELTA, Santalaceae (read 2026-10-17): lamina undivided, one-veined or pinnate; some leaves much reduced or spiny. Wikipedia: simple, some reduced to scales.
